# Safe & Responsible AI Use at Work — delivery kit

*Everyone (compliance-style short course) · 1.5 hours · level 1 · certification: aware*

| What | Where | Edit it |
|---|---|---|
| Slides | `slides/slides.md` | edit, then `python scripts/build_slides.py` |
| Working demos (3) — offline; richer with an LLM key | `demos/NN_*.py`, `demos/run_all.py` | plain Python on the shared toolkit `training-materials/labkit/` |

## You will be able to

- Apply the company AI policy
- Recognise prompt-injection and deepfake risks
- Know when disclosure is required
- Know how to report an AI incident

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_allowed_or_not.py` | 1 | 15 | an AI-use policy written as data, applied to ten real situations with the rule that decided each |
| 2 | `02_spot_the_attack.py` | 2 | 15 | eight inputs run through real controls (hidden-text stripping, injection classifier, PII redaction) and a red-flag checklist for a voice-clone payment request |
| 3 | `03_incident_triage.py` | 3 | 12 | a triage rule set that turns a description into severity, owner, first actions and a filled incident report |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
